content:
Based on the provided screenshot of the **EaseUS Data Recovery Wizard Free** application, here is the precise UI audit.

### 1) LAYOUT
*   **Window Bounds:** 1024x768 (Maximized, standard Windows desktop).
*   **Header (Top Bar):** [0, 0, 1024, 60]. Contains app title, navigation breadcrumbs, and primary action buttons.
*   **Toolbar:** [0, 80, 1024, 130]. Contains view toggles, Filter button, and Search bar.
*   **Navigation Pane (Left):** [0, 135, 275, 840]. Tree-view structure for file paths.
*   **Main Content Area (Center):** [280, 135, 795, 840]. List view of files/folders with columns.
*   **Details/Preview Pane (Right):** [800, 135, 990, 840]. Displays selected item properties and preview.
*   **Status Bar (Bottom):** [0, 850, 1024, 940]. Shows scan status summary and the "Recover All" action button.
*   **Windows Taskbar:** [0, 945, 1024, 999].

### 2) TEXT
*   **Header Title:** `EaseUS Data Recovery Wizard Free`
*   **Breadcrumb:** `Windows (C:)`
*   **Toolbar Buttons:** `Filter`, `Search files or folders` (placeholder)
*   **Nav Pane Tabs:** `Path` (Selected), `Type`
*   **Nav Items:**
    *   `Windows (C:)` | `1.1M`
    *   `File Path Lost` | `4.3K`
    *   `Reconstructed` | `87`
*   **List Headers:** `Name`, `Date Modified`, `Type`
*   **List Items (Sample):**
    *   `actionarchivecache` | `10/7/2026 11:30 PM` | `File folder`
    *   `actions-runner` | `10/17/2026 4:12 PM` | `File folder`
    *   `azureCli` | `10/8/2026 1:50 AM` | `File folder`
    *   *(...remaining rows follow same format)*
*   **Preview Pane:**
    *   `actionarchivecache`
    *   `Open`
    *   `Size`: `284 MB`
    *   `Date Modified`: `10/7/2026 11:30 PM`
    *   `Path`: `C:\`
*   **Status Bar:** `Scan Completed, Files Found:` **`1139261`** `(147.04 GB)`
*   **Action Button:** `Recover All ...`

### 3) COLOR
*   **App Background:** `#F5F8FA` (Light gray-blue).
*   **Surface/Pane Backgrounds:** `#FFFFFF` (White).
*   **Primary Accent (Button):** `#3B82F6` (Bright Blue).
*   **Selection State (Row):** `#DBEAFE` (Light Blue background).
*   **Text Primary:** `#1F2937` (Dark Gray/Black).
*   **Text Secondary/Metadata:** `#6B7280` (Medium Gray).
*   **Text on Primary Button:** `#FFFFFF` (White).
*   **Borders/Dividers:** `#E5E7EB` (Light Gray).
*   **Success Icon (Checkmark):** `#3B82F6` (Blue circle background), White icon.

### 4) TYPOGRAPHY
*   **App Title:** Sans-serif (Segoe UI/Inter), ~11px, Normal weight.
*   **Breadcrumbs:** Sans-serif, ~13px, Normal.
*   **Column Headers:** Sans-serif, ~12px, Normal, Dark Gray.
*   **List Items:** Sans-serif, ~13px, Normal.
*   **Metadata Text (Dates/Sizes):** Sans-serif, ~12px, Normal, Medium Gray.
*   **Status Bar Summary:** Sans-serif, ~14px, Bold (for numbers), Normal (for label).
*   **Button Text:** Sans-serif, ~13px, Normal/Medium.

### 5) SPACING & SIZING
*   **Row Height (List):** ~42px per row.
*   **Icon Size (Folder):** 24x24px or 32x32px inside list items.
*   **Padding (Internal):** ~16px horizontal padding in panes.
*   **Gutter (Between Panes):** ~4-5px (divider line).
*   **Border Radius:**
    *   Buttons: ~4px - 6px.
    *   Search Bar: ~4px.
    *   Preview Card: ~8px.
*   **Status Bar Height:** ~90px.
*   **Recover Button Dimensions:** ~160px width x 44px height.

### 6) CONTROLS & STATES
*   **Tabs (Path/Type):** Segmented control style. `Path` is **Active/Selected** (White bg, shadow/border). `Type` is **Inactive** (Gray bg).
*   **Checkboxes (List):** Square checkboxes. Currently all appear **Unchecked**. The header checkbox is **Unchecked**.
*   **List Row Selection:** The row `actionarchivecache` is **Selected** (highlighted blue background).
*   **Search Input:** Standard text input, **Empty** state with placeholder text.
*   **Filter Button:** Tertiary button, **Normal** state.
*   **Open Button (Preview):** Secondary button style (Light blue bg), **Enabled**.
*   **Recover All Button:** Primary CTA button (Solid blue), **Enabled** state.
*   **Navigation Arrows (Top Left):** Back/Forward buttons. Back looks **Disabled** (grayed out), Forward looks **Disabled** or just normal inactive.

### 7) ICONOGRAPHY
*   **Style:** Flat, Outline/Filled hybrid (mostly filled for folders, outline for actions).
*   **Folder Icons:** Standard Windows-style folder, blue color.
*   **Action Icons:**
    *   Home (House shape)
    *   Back Arrow (Left chevron)
    *   Up Arrow (Level up)
    *   Filter (Funnel)
    *   Search (Magnifying glass)
    *   View Toggle (List/Grid icons)
*   **App Specific:** Shopping cart icon on "Buy Now", Shield/Info icon next to it.
*   **Status Icon:** Large Checkmark inside a circle (bottom left).

### 8) STATE
*   **Page State:** **Success / Data Loaded**.
    *   The scan process has finished ("Scan Completed").
    *   Data is populated in the list (1.13M files found).
    *   User is currently browsing results without having selected specific files for recovery yet (checkboxes empty).
*   **Focus:** Implicit focus is likely on the file list or the "Recover All" action given the completion status.
*   **System Time:** 4:30 PM, 10/17/2026 (visible in taskbar).
